summary.summary: A caller claiming to represent Medicare created urgency around Margaret's benefits and asked her to verify sensitive account details. Eufisky paused and ended the call before information was shared.
summary.caller_claim: Michael said he was calling from Medicare about an urgent benefits update.
summary.intervention: Eufisky placed the caller on hold and privately warned Margaret.
summary.outcome: Margaret ended the call and the number was blocked.
summary.recommendation: Keep the number blocked and contact Medicare through the number on an official statement if follow-up is needed.

incidents.redacted_transcript:
Caller: This is Michael from Medicare. Your benefits will be suspended today unless we verify your account.
Caller: Please read the number on your Medicare card and confirm the bank account ending in ####.
Margaret: I am not giving you that. End the call.

summary.summary: The caller pretended to be Margaret's grandson and said he needed bail money immediately. Margaret recognized the pressure after Eufisky's warning and chose to end the call.
summary.caller_claim: The caller claimed to be Margaret's grandson in legal trouble.
requests_made: Keep the call secret from family
summary.disclosed_by_senior: Margaret did not share financial information.
summary.intervention: Eufisky paused the caller and explained the family-emergency pattern privately.
summary.recommendation: Call the grandson on his known number before responding to any future emergency request.

incidents.redacted_transcript:
Caller: Grandma, it is me. I am in trouble and need bail money right now. Please do not tell Mom.
Margaret: I will call my grandson directly. End this call.

summary.summary: Greenway Pharmacy called to say Margaret's prescription was ready. The short call contained no payment request, urgency, or sensitive-information request.
summary.caller_claim: The caller identified the business as Greenway Pharmacy.
summary.intervention: No intervention was needed; Eufisky monitored quietly.
summary.outcome: Margaret thanked the pharmacy and ended the call normally.
summary.recommendation: No action needed. Consider adding this verified pharmacy number to trusted contacts.

incidents.redacted_transcript:
Caller: Hello Margaret, this is Greenway Pharmacy. Your prescription is ready for pickup.
Margaret: Thank you. I will collect it this afternoon.
